play.Ball hog: Holds the ball and shoots a lot.
play.Team player: Looks to pass first and racks up assists.
play.Clutch: Shooting percentage rises late in close games.
play.Choker: Shooting wobbles late in close games.
play.Defensive pest: Strong at pressing, steals and blocks.
play.Leader: Boosts teammates' shooting and morale on the floor.

pers.Hard worker: Fast offseason growth and slow decline.
pers.Lazy: Slow growth, tires quickly, high injury risk.
pers.Hothead: Commits frequent fouls; morale swings wildly.
pers.Composed: Stays steady at the line and in close-game finishes.
pers.Proud: Morale drops sharply on the bench and rises as a starter.
pers.Cheerful: Lifts the locker room and boosts team morale.
pers.Passionate: Dives for rebounds and loose balls. Slightly higher energy cost.

pa.Money-minded: Hard to sign if the salary falls short of the ask.
pa.Title-chaser: Will take less than the ask to join a contender.
pa.Loyal: Strongly prefers re-signing with the original team.
pa.Easygoing: Signs without fuss if the terms are right.

sig.Killer Crossover: High chance of shaking the defender with a crossover, and strings two or three moves together.
sig.Shammgod: A dribble that pushes the ball out with one hand and pulls it back with the other.
sig.In-and-out: Fakes the crossover, then brings it back with the same hand.
sig.Spin move: Turns away from the defender and spins out a full 360.
sig.Step-back three: Steps back to create space and shoots.
sig.Side-step three: Hops to the side to dodge the defender and lets the three fly.
sig.Deep three: Shoots without hesitation from way beyond the arc.
sig.One-leg fadeaway: A fadeaway shot leaning back with one knee raised.
sig.Dream Shake: In the post, uses shoulder and pivot fakes to get the defender in the air, then spins the other way and shoots.
sig.Skyhook: A hook shot with a full arm extension and a high release point. Hard to block.
sig.Drop step: Back to the basket, steps toward the baseline and finishes with power.
sig.Turnaround fadeaway: Turns around in the post and shoots fading away.
sig.Euro-step: Wide steps in opposite directions to dodge the defender before going up.
sig.Hop step: Jump-stops on both feet, then rises up balanced.
sig.Floater: A high-arcing shot that floats over the big man.
sig.Finger roll: A soft layup that rolls off the fingertips.
sig.No-look pass: Looks the other way while passing to fool the defense.
sig.Behind-the-back pass: A pass wrapped around the back.
sig.Dunk artist: Frequently throws down windmill, 360, between-the-legs and reverse dunks.
sig.Self alley-oop: Tosses it up to himself, then leaps, catches and slams it.
sig.Chase-down block: Chases from behind and swats the layup.
sig.Strip: Knocks the ball away from a driver from behind.
sig.Putback: Finishes with a dunk or tip-in right off the offensive rebound.
sig.Jab step: Pokes a foot out to back the defender off, then shoots or drives.
sig.Hesitation: Hesitates mid-dribble to freeze the defender, then explodes past him.
sig.Between-the-legs combo: Chains between-the-legs dribbles to set his rhythm.
sig.Half hook: A short hook with a half turn near the basket. Hard to block.
sig.Trailer three: Trails the break and lets it fly from the top.
sig.Slap steal: Slaps the ball away from the handler in front of him.
sig.Outlet pass: Grabs the rebound and fires it ahead to start the break.

Prefers to score himself over passing

How often he goes away from the screen
How often he posts up near the basket
High: backs his man down. Low: turns and faces up
How much he looks to pass before shooting
How often he throws no-look and behind-the-back passes
How often he throws lobs at the rim
How often he feeds the big man in the post
How often he kicks it out when help comes on the drive
How often he cuts into an empty paint

High: rolls to the rim after the screen. Low: pops out to the arc

How much he jumps passing lanes to pick off passes

floor: Runs the game and sets up teammates.
slasher: Attacks the rim off the drive.
creator: Shot creator
Makes his own shot off the dribble.
lock: Gets the other team's best scorer.
pointf: Runs the offense from the forward spot.
energy: Dives for rebounds and loose balls.
stretch: A big man who shoots threes.
roller: Rolls hard off the screen and finishes.
postsc: Scores with his back to the basket.
playbig: A big man who runs the offense with his passing.
blue: Does the dirty work: screens and defense.
clutch: At his best late in close games.

corner: Stands in the corner to stretch the defense, and shoots the three when it comes.
spot: Waits at one spot on the arc and shoots off the catch.
mover: Keeps moving off screens to get open shots.
cutter: Cuts to an empty rim when his man looks away.
dunker: Sits beside the rim and finishes dump-offs and rebounds.
post: Sets up on the block and calls for the ball.
hub: Catches near the free-throw line and runs the offense with passes.
pop: Sets the screen and pops out for the three.
runner: Takes off early on the other team's shot to run the break.

Team defense. Higher means opponents shoot slightly worse.

Players lose less morale after defeats.
How fast he reads the other side and changes the plan mid-game. Low means he stubbornly sticks with it.
How much he gambles: presses, intentional fouls, hunting foul trouble.
High: he rides his starters and keeps a tight rotation. Low: he goes deep into the bench.
